title: 白
white
馬
horse
篇
poem
couplets: 白馬飾金羈，連翩西北馳

A white horse in a golden bridle
gallops on, on, to the northwest.
借問誰家子，幽并遊俠兒

Whose son is he, you ask?
A wandering knight from You and Bing.
少小去鄉邑，揚聲沙漠垂

He left his home town as a boy;
his name rang out to the desert's edge.
宿昔秉良弓，楛矢何參差

Night and day he held a fine bow,
his thorn-wood arrows bristling.
控弦破左的，右發摧月支

He draws and splits the left-hand target,
shoots right and smashes the Yuezhi mark.
仰手接飛猱，俯身散馬蹄

Hand raised, he hits the leaping ape;
leaning low, he shatters the horse-hoof mark.
狡捷過猴猿，勇慓若豹螭

Nimbler than monkeys,
fierce as leopard or dragon.
邊城多警急，胡虜數遷移

The border towns raise alarm on alarm;
the Hu raiders shift again and again.
羽檄從北來，厲馬登髙堤

Feathered dispatches come from the north;
he spurs his horse up the high bank.
長驅蹈匈奴，左顧凌鮮卑

He drives deep and tramples the Xiongnu,
turns left and crushes the Xianbei.
棄身鋒刃端，性命安可懐

He gives his body to the sword's edge;
how could he cling to his life?
父母且不顧，何言子與妻

He gives no thought even to his parents,
let alone his wife and son.
名編壯士籍，不得中顧私

His name is on the roll of warriors;
he may not turn to private cares.
捐軀赴國難，視死忽如歸

He gives his life for his country's need
and meets death like going home.
